newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures trade narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures trade narrowly mixed.

text.p: July 8 - U.S. debt futures traded narrowly mixed in light afternoon trade. Sept T-bonds rose to 113-28/32, above resistance at 113-25/32 on local short-covering. Resistance is at the seven-mos high at 113-31/32. Traders said U.S. Redbook retail sales, which will be released this afternoon, are seen rising 1.7 pct. ((Chicago derivatives desk (312)408-8750))
